scripts.phase:canary: node -e "const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js'); const u=process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL||process.env.SUPABASE_URL; const k=process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY||process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY; if(!u||!k){console.error('Missing SUPABASE envs'); process.exit(1);} const s=createClient(u,k); s.rpc('compute_flight_api_phase_state',{ p_now_utc:new Date().toISOString(), p_sched_dep_utc:new Date(Date.now()+3600000).toISOString(), p_sched_arr_utc:new Date(Date.now()+3*3600000).toISOString(), p_est_dep_utc:null, p_est_arr_utc:null, p_actual_off_utc:null, p_actual_on_utc:null, p_status_text:null, p_is_cancelled:false, p_is_diverted:false, p_airborne_signal:false, p_landed_signal:false }).then(({data,error})=>{ if(error){console.error(error.message); process.exit(1);} if(!data){console.error('No phase returned'); process.exit(1);} console.log('[phase-canary] OK phase='+data); }).catch((e)=>{ console.error(e); process.exit(1);});"
